title: Magic Quadrant for Cloud-Native Application Protection Platforms
methodology: Composite scores derived from CNAPP capability data (7 pillars / 29 sub-pillars) and CNAPP MQ Gap heuristics (7 pillars / 27 sub-pillars). 14 MQ criteria computed per CNAPP_MQ_Gap_Schema_App.json mq_scoring_mode and weighted to produce ATE (Y) and COV (X) composites. Quadrant assigned by population median split.
